notes.en: Drew a Vitruvian Man with the classic dual-pose overlay emphasizing the circle-square geometry. The gold body uses a bold base layer for small sizes and three tiers of aged-ink etch for progressive detail: main contours and pose separations at ~64px, muscle definition and hair at ~96px, and facial features, fingers, toes and ribs at ~150px. The figure reads cleanly at all sizes from navbar (38px) through large display, though the finest anatomical detail is subtle and may still benefit from stronger edge definition in the smallest sizes.
